observations: Photos 0 and 2: a used automatic gearbox with a transfer case bolted to the rear, so a 4x4 unit, lying on a wet concrete floor in a parts yard.
Photos 0 and 2: the gearbox is still bolted to an engine; a strap runs around the bell housing; cooler lines and harness attached.
Photos 0 and 2: a white label on the transfer case is not legible; paint and chalk marks 'CA' and 'PB' on the casing; rust on the output flanges and a bracket.
Photo 1: the same gearbox attached to a V6 petrol engine with a black plastic intake manifold, a yellow dipstick handle and alternator; no engine badge legible.
All photos: watermark 'GEARUP INC.', a parts dealer's photos, with many other engines and gearboxes around.
No photo shows a readable transmission ID tag, part number or Jeep marking, and nothing shows the unit running.

read_from: photos 0, 1, 2 general shape only; transfer case label not legible

claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 2 show a transfer case with front and rear outputs attached.
No legible ID tag or part number; the attached V6 in photo 1 carries no readable badge. Fitment rests on the seller's words.
Origin cannot be shown by photos of the part.
No odometer screenshot from the donor vehicle or any mileage record.

risks.risk: Gearbox is not the Jeep Wrangler 3.6 unit claimed, or is from a different year range, so it may not fit
risks.proof: A sharp close-up of the transmission ID tag or stamped part number and of the transfer case label
risks.if_unproven: fitment unconfirmed, cannot be priced as a Wrangler gearbox

risks.risk: Internal wear, slipping or faulty valve body
risks.proof: A clip of it running and shifting through the gears in a vehicle or on the dealer's test rig
A photo of fluid from the gearbox on white paper

risks.risk: Offer may be gearbox only while photos show it bolted to an engine
risks.proof: A written list of what is included and a photo of exactly those parts
risks.if_unproven: as gearbox and transfer case only

risks.risk: Dealer stock photo, not the exact unit offered
risks.proof: A photo of the unit with a handwritten code and today's date on it

proof_requests: A sharp close-up of the transmission ID tag or part number and the transfer case label
A photo of the unit with a handwritten code and today's date
A clip of it running and shifting
A photo of the fluid on white paper
A list and photo of exactly what is included
response.reason: The photos show a used 4x4 automatic gearbox with transfer case, but its ID tag is not legible and the fitment that sets the price rests on the seller's words alone. A close-up of the tag is needed before even a worst case price.
